reason: The filing provides extensive market and disease prevalence data (e.g., 11.4% of children or 7.1 million aged 3-17 and 6% of adults or 15.5 million had ADHD diagnosis in 2022-2023; 24.3% prevalence of chronic pain among US adults; economic costs of chronic pain estimated at $722.8 billion in 2021; 133.2 million opioid prescriptions in 2025). However, none of these statistics represent a Total Addressable Market (TAM) disclosed by Collegium Pharmaceutical itself.
